name: Pocket Symbolic Solver
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Without "=", the solver solves expression = 0, so x+1 gives x = -1.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pocket Symbolic Solver is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for doing your math in Obsidian with it.
